newsitem.title: USA: Seagull Esso buy to double oil production.
newsitem.headline: Seagull Esso buy to double oil production.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said Wednesday it has closed on a previously announced purchase of Esso Suez Inc stock and certain assets of Esso Egypt Ltd.
The company said it paid about $74 million in the deal, which it funded by drawing on existing credit.
The acquisitions will more than double company-wide crude oil production and "make a substantial and immediate impact on Seagull's operating results," Seagull Chairman Barry Galt said.

Esso Suez Inc owns a 100 percent interest in the offshore East Zeit oil producing concession of the Gulf of Suez, where crude oil production net to the acquired Seagull interest averages between 4,000 and 5,000 barrels daily.
Esso Egypt owns the entire working interest in the South Hurghada exploration onshore concession on the coast of the Gulf of Suez about 250 miles southeast of Cairo.

Seagull estimates the East Zeit production concession contains more than 17 million net barrels of proved oil reserves and it expects substantial additional reserves will result from exploitation drilling on identified reservoirs.
